findings.detail: First speed selection authenticates model_final.pt at normal REC actor15000 completion. Legacy speed/terrain/jump/stepjump records are archived, and checkpoints without joint metadata are excluded from own-source selection. Later domains require completed same-lineage parent and retain own latest sealed recovery. Source receipt binds origin and actual parent full-state bytes. Trainer runner.load + verify_learning_state_restore still performs native actor/critic/Adam comparison and restores saved RNG.

Original claim is required under the existing exclusive lock; all legacy attempts, reservations and completed work are charged monotonically. Remaining joint allowance subtracts legacy domain/global consumption and remaining critic adaptation. Fresh joint clocks are not derived from old independent actor consumption. Receipt checks authoritative current claim as well as immutable admission snapshots, preventing a stale allowance from ignoring new consumption.

Critic warmup is frozen ten updates for a new domain or its sealed remaining count on own resume. Actor requires_grad and actor_enabled control the original PPO update. Only optimizer return increments successful_updates and actor_updates_in_block; task/component metadata is updated immediately after that return and only by actor commits. Infos, per-file seal, progress and final completion share computed metadata. Critic-only work stays charged without progressing fresh actor clocks.

Requested actor work is min(endpoint minus actual fresh domain actor clock, maximum available after adaptation). Normal completed flag requires the full admitted update count and actor delta. Dispatcher further accepts termination only at fresh endpoint or charged domain/global cap and uses actual sealed parent clock for subsequent component starts. It never substitutes a legacy finished record or assumes the planned15000 was actually learned.

Static recipe validates component schemas using zeros but contains no learning_source or clocks_at_source. Static geometry expectation is explicitly marked static_recipe_preflight. Environment rejects that placeholder before native construction; actual attach_runtime removes it only after selection/account authentication and installs sealed component clocks. Scoped design resolves actual clocks before instance observation and is independently reauthenticated at native constructor entry.

Eight actual comparisons across four domains and two seeds preserve every original fixed input; only three declared provenance fields differ.

All four native workers save a truthy regression-recovery initial_state checkpoint at startup. Intermediate broad own-source glob included this zero-update save; after a resumed attempt it collided with the previous source consumption clock and the strict cross-attempt fork guard. Final helper authenticates its exact native initial_state location, completion scope/status, zero successful updates, SHA, parent count, full native/REC-origin and component clocks, requires no terminal claim, then excludes it before duplicate/source selection. Original native saving and strict cross-attempt fork refusal remain intact. Reviewed fix is helper SHA6046cd4818250bd260748c14a120f9f42c93b6595a6037648c9016d10077804c; no actual checkpoint/resume execution by this reviewer.

Read-only review only; no scripts executed. Source staging confines the target/archive to fixed source_integrated_v24_20261008, validates frozen archive/complete inventory and legacy contracts, and leaves process/account ownership intact. Stage-observer creates only named source026 external files after predecessor pins. CPU native preflight runs before retirement with no simulator/runner. Retirement pins only old waiting observer PID3838548/starttime104425599, entry and waiting/REC-incomplete state, signals via pidfd, reauthenticates PPO owners and checks preserved files. Explicit sequence is native preflight success -> retire old waiting observer -> new frozen observer --check-only -> start source026 waiting observer. The new check_only helper requires retirement receipt/PPO_signals0, validates waiting status and absence of state/action intents. start requires that check-only waiting status, verifies staged bytes/single observer and exact command, and checks original PPO owners again. A direct preflight->retire->start sequence would lack status; root confirmed the explicit added check-only step. Later normal-boundary signaling/native startup remains a separate queue phase.
